slok.be:
যথৈধাংসি সমিদ্ধোঽগ্নির্ভস্মসাত্কুরুতেঽর্জুন |
জ্ঞানাগ্নিঃ সর্বকর্মাণি ভস্মসাত্কুরুতে তথা ||৪-৩৭||
slok.en:
yathaidhāṃsi samiddho.agnirbhasmasātkurute.arjuna .
jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasātkurute tathā ||4-37||
slok.hi:
यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन |
ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा ||४-३७||
slok.ka:
ಯಥೈಧಾಂಸಿ ಸಮಿದ್ಧೋಽಗ್ನಿರ್ಭಸ್ಮಸಾತ್ಕುರುತೇಽರ್ಜುನ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಾಗ್ನಿಃ ಸರ್ವಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಭಸ್ಮಸಾತ್ಕುರುತೇ ತಥಾ ||೪-೩೭||

verse_translation.life_application: Let the fire of self-knowledge consume your past guilt, regrets, and limiting beliefs today.

commentary.text: 4.37 As a blazing fire reduces fuel to ashes, O Arjuna, so does the fire of Knowledge reduce all karmas to ashes.

slok.be:
সমোঽহং সর্বভূতেষু ন মে দ্বেষ্যোঽস্তি ন প্রিযঃ |
যে ভজন্তি তু মাং ভক্ত্যা মযি তে তেষু চাপ্যহম্ ||৯-২৯||
slok.en:
samo.ahaṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo.asti na priyaḥ .
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham ||9-29||
slok.hi:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः |
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ||९-२९||
slok.ka:
ಸಮೋಽಹಂ ಸರ್ವಭೂತೇಷು ನ ಮೇ ದ್ವೇಷ್ಯೋಽಸ್ತಿ ನ ಪ್ರಿಯಃ |
ಯೇ ಭಜನ್ತಿ ತು ಮಾಂ ಭಕ್ತ್ಯಾ ಮಯಿ ತೇ ತೇಷು ಚಾಪ್ಯಹಮ್ ||೯-೨೯||

verse_translation.life_application: Realize God is equal to all beings, hating none and favoring none; yet those who worship with love abide in God.

commentary.text: 9.29 The same am I to all beings; to Me there is none hateful or dear; but those who worship Me with devotion, they are in Me and I also in them.

slok.be:
নিরাশীর্যতচিত্তাত্মা ত্যক্তসর্বপরিগ্রহঃ |
শারীরং কেবলং কর্ম কুর্বন্নাপ্নোতি কিল্বিষম্ ||৪-২১||
slok.en:
nirāśīryatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ .
śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam ||4-21||
slok.hi:
निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः |
शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ||४-२१||
slok.ka:
ನಿರಾಶೀರ್ಯತಚಿತ್ತಾತ್ಮಾ ತ್ಯಕ್ತಸರ್ವಪರಿಗ್ರಹಃ |
ಶಾರೀರಂ ಕೇವಲಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಕುರ್ವನ್ನಾಪ್ನೋತಿ ಕಿಲ್ಬಿಷಮ್ ||೪-೨೧||

verse_translation.life_application: Simplify your desires and lifestyle today, taking only what is necessary while performing your duties without greed.

commentary.text: 4.21 Without desire, with mind and self controlled, having abandoned all possessions, performing action by the body alone, he incurs no sin.

slok.be:
মানাপমানযোস্তুল্যস্তুল্যো মিত্রারিপক্ষযোঃ |
সর্বারম্ভপরিত্যাগী গুণাতীতঃ স উচ্যতে ||১৪-২৫||
slok.en:
mānāpamānayostulyastulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ .
sarvārambhaparityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate ||14-25||
slok.hi:
मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः |
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते ||१४-२५||
slok.ka:
ಮಾನಾಪಮಾನಯೋಸ್ತುಲ್ಯಸ್ತುಲ್ಯೋ ಮಿತ್ರಾರಿಪಕ್ಷಯೋಃ |
ಸರ್ವಾರಮ್ಭಪರಿತ್ಯಾಗೀ ಗುಣಾತೀತಃ ಸ ಉಚ್ಯತೇ ||೧೪-೨೫||

verse_translation.life_application: Same in honor and dishonor, same to friend and foe, abandoning all selfish undertakings—he is said to transcend modes.

commentary.text: 14.25 One who is equal in honor and dishonor, equal towards the sides of both friend and foe, and who has renounced all initiative (undertakings)—such a person is said to have transcended the gunas (qualities).

slok.be:
যজ্ঞে তপসি দানে চ স্থিতিঃ সদিতি চোচ্যতে |
কর্ম চৈব তদর্থীযং সদিত্যেবাভিধীযতে ||১৭-২৭||
slok.en:
yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ saditi cocyate .
karma caiva tadarthīyaṃ sadityevābhidhīyate ||17-27||
slok.hi:
यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते |
कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते ||१७-२७||
slok.ka:
ಯಜ್ಞೇ ತಪಸಿ ದಾನೇ ಚ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಃ ಸದಿತಿ ಚೋಚ್ಯತೇ |
ಕರ್ಮ ಚೈವ ತದರ್ಥೀಯಂ ಸದಿತ್ಯೇವಾಭಿಧೀಯತೇ ||೧೭-೨೭||

verse_translation.life_application: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity, gift is called 'Sat'; action for sake of That is also called 'Sat'.

commentary.text: 17.27 Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity, and charity is also called 'SAT'; and also action for the sake of the Supreme is verily named as 'SAT'.

verse_translation.life_application: Maintain dispassion toward sense objects, absence of egoism, and perception of evil in birth, death, old age, sickness.

commentary.text: 13.8 Humility, unpretentiousness, non-violence, forgiveness, straightforwardness, service to the Teacher, purity, steadfastness, and self-control.

slok.be:
অপি চেত্সুদুরাচারো ভজতে মামনন্যভাক্ |
সাধুরেব স মন্তব্যঃ সম্যগ্ব্যবসিতো হি সঃ ||৯-৩০||
slok.en:
api cetsudurācāro bhajate māmananyabhāk .
sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ ||9-30||
slok.hi:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक् |
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ||९-३०||
slok.ka:
ಅಪಿ ಚೇತ್ಸುದುರಾಚಾರೋ ಭಜತೇ ಮಾಮನನ್ಯಭಾಕ್ |
ಸಾಧುರೇವ ಸ ಮನ್ತವ್ಯಃ ಸಮ್ಯಗ್ವ್ಯವಸಿತೋ ಹಿ ಸಃ ||೯-೩೦||

verse_translation.life_application: Even if a person of bad conduct worships God with undivided devotion, consider them righteous, for they have resolved rightly.

commentary.text: 9.30 Even if the most sinful person worships Me with unswerving devotion, he must be regarded as righteous, for he has rightly resolved.

slok.be:
ধৃতরাষ্ট্র উবাচ |
ধর্মক্ষেত্রে কুরুক্ষেত্রে সমবেতা যুযুত্সবঃ |
মামকাঃ পাণ্ডবাশ্চৈব কিমকুর্বত সঞ্জয ||১-১||
slok.en:
dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca .
dharmakṣetre kurukṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ .
māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāścaiva kimakurvata sañjaya ||1-1||
slok.hi:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच |
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः |
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ||१-१||
slok.ka:
ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ಉವಾಚ |
ಧರ್ಮಕ್ಷೇತ್ರೇ ಕುರುಕ್ಷೇತ್ರೇ ಸಮವೇತಾ ಯುಯುತ್ಸವಃ |
ಮಾಮಕಾಃ ಪಾಣ್ಡವಾಶ್ಚೈವ ಕಿಮಕುರ್ವತ ಸಞ್ಜಯ ||೧-೧||

verse_translation.life_application: Notice when personal bias clouds your judgment today, and seek an honest, objective perspective before taking any action.

commentary.text: 1.1 Dhritarashtra said -- O Sanjaya! What did my sons and the sons of Pandu, assembled together on the holy field of Kurukshetra and eager to fight (yuyutsavah), do?

slok.be:
তস্য সঞ্জনযন্হর্ষং কুরুবৃদ্ধঃ পিতামহঃ |
সিংহনাদং বিনদ্যোচ্চৈঃ শঙ্খং দধ্মৌ প্রতাপবান্ ||১-১২||
slok.en:
tasya sañjanayanharṣaṃ kuruvṛddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ .
siṃhanādaṃ vinadyoccaiḥ śaṅkhaṃ dadhmau pratāpavān ||1-12||
slok.hi:
तस्य सञ्जनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः |
सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान् ||१-१२||
slok.ka:
ತಸ್ಯ ಸಞ್ಜನಯನ್ಹರ್ಷಂ ಕುರುವೃದ್ಧಃ ಪಿತಾಮಹಃ |
ಸಿಂಹನಾದಂ ವಿನದ್ಯೋಚ್ಚೈಃ ಶಙ್ಖಂ ದಧ್ಮೌ ಪ್ರತಾಪವಾನ್ ||೧-೧೨||

verse_translation.life_application: Offer encouragement and confidence to those under your care when they feel anxious or uncertain.

commentary.text: 1.12 At that moment, Bhishma, the aged and mighty grandsire of the Kauravas, roared loudly like a lion and blew his conch, filling Duryodhana's heart with joy.

slok.be:
ওমিত্যেকাক্ষরং ব্রহ্ম ব্যাহরন্মামনুস্মরন্ |
যঃ প্রযাতি ত্যজন্দেহং স যাতি পরমাং গতিম্ ||৮-১৩||
slok.en:
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanmāmanusmaran .
yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||8-13||
slok.hi:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् |
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ||८-१३||
slok.ka:
ಓಮಿತ್ಯೇಕಾಕ್ಷರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ವ್ಯಾಹರನ್ಮಾಮನುಸ್ಮರನ್ |
ಯಃ ಪ್ರಯಾತಿ ತ್ಯಜನ್ದೇಹಂ ಸ ಯಾತಿ ಪರಮಾಂ ಗತಿಮ್ ||೮-೧೩||

verse_translation.life_application: Utter the sacred sound while remembering the divine presence as you leave the body to attain the supreme goal.

commentary.text: 8.13 Uttering the monosyllable Om, the Brahman, and remembering Me, he who departs, leaving the body, attains the Supreme Goal.
